purpose: Prevent silent weakening of tests, schemas, inspection gates, and integrity policy in SOURCE_UPDATE artifacts.

build_token_only_change.description: Only exact current/next Build identifiers and derived cache tokens may differ; all other bytes must remain equal after normalization.

protection_scope_description: Baseline approval semantics remain authoritative, while protected path matching uses the union of baseline and applied protected_patterns so a policy expansion cannot modify newly protected files in the same update without approval.

machine_derived_hash_sync.description: Allow only mechanically verifiable size/SHA-256 synchronization in explicitly listed protected manifests. Paths, membership, ordering, schema, purpose, and non-derived fields must remain byte-semantically unchanged; baseline and final applied-tree derived values must match the referenced files exactly. A structurally derived-only sync with missing/stale/fabricated reference facts is an integrity failure and must not fall back to human approval.
